data.overview: A reclusive technology magnate invites a skeptical computer scientist to study a fragment of unknown origin at his island laboratory. When their experiment draws a reply from beyond Earth, the isolated team must decide whether it is an invitation or a warning.
data.tagline: The first reply may be the last.
data.title: Contact at Blackwater Key
